greenfield_preflight.defect: False-positive classification of greenfield missions (e.g., LabFlow) as modifying existing application due to negative/conditional guidance like 'If any existing files are present, do not overwrite them.' and false file detection from .artifacts directory.
greenfield_preflight.resolution: Implemented _should_require_existing_application() in core/agent_loop/loop.py with negative instruction stripping, strict modifier regexes, and robust workspace file filtering that ignores all hidden directories/metadata (.artifacts, .hermes, .git, etc.).

file_tools.defect: WriteFileTool direct writes risked partial corruption on crashes; lack of dictionary input handling could cause attribute failures under injected harness parameters.
file_tools.resolution: Added Pydantic Input coercion in execute/execute_async for ReadFileTool and WriteFileTool. Added atomic file write with temporary hidden file, safe directory creation, and atomic os.replace with Windows file-lock retry.

planning_and_failure_handling.defect: AgentLoop blindly exhausted 5 consecutive failure budget when encountering external network/provider outages (Condition C / Condition D), falsely failing missions instead of pausing in WAITING.
planning_and_failure_handling.resolution: Integrated classify_error_condition() in AgentLoop error handling to truthfully classify outages as WAITING_FOR_PROVIDER (Condition C) or WAITING_FOR_NETWORK (Condition D) and persist recovery state without burning turn budgets.

event_synchronization.defect: gui/src/sync.ts processIncomingSnapshot pruned all events sequence <= last_sequence. In gui/src/App.tsx, setStreamEvents was overwritten with this pruned list, erasing the activity log in ActivityPanel on snapshot reception.
event_synchronization.resolution: Updated gui/src/App.tsx to accumulate and deduplicate streamEvents in a persistent bounded ring buffer (1000 events max), preserving unbroken activity logs across snapshots.

runtime_identity.defect: No runtime code fingerprinting existed between the live background uvicorn server and files on disk, allowing code drift or stale server execution.
runtime_identity.resolution: Added SHA-256 code fingerprinting, PID attribution, and server startup timestamp verification to /api/health in core/server/app.py and core/server/launcher.py.
